names.form: Св. Јован Богослов, апостол и јеванђелист

names.note: His own name, read out of «Св. Јован Богослов, апостол и јеванђелист» — the line already recorded here, which joins two of the titles with “and”, so `pickNameForms` refuses to print it for one person and the reader was shown English instead.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru for 26 сентября ст. ст.: “Преставление апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (начало II)”. The bounds are that phrase — the beginning of the second century — and not a recorded year.

feast.note: The Russian line is «Преставление», his falling asleep, and puts it at the beginning of the second century.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 26 сентября ст. ст. — «Преставление апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (начало II).»

feast.note: doxologia.ro also names him in «Soborul Sfinților 12 Apostoli» on 30 iunie, the Synaxis of the Twelve Apostles, whose life calls him «Sfântul Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan, Cuvântătorul de Dumnezeu» (read 24 September 2026). One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: doxologia.ro, 26 Septembrie — „Adormirea Sfântului Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan”
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 26 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση)»

feast.note: First of the two the Ohrid Prologue enumerates for this day. Read off the Prologue text on the page and not off its entry list, which prints one of the two. **The Prologue keeps him twice and the second day is recorded here, because one attestation row per church is the schema.** Its Julian 8. мај ст. ст. heads an entry „Свети апостол и јеванђелист Јован.“ whose first sentence is a cross-reference back to this very day — „Спомен овог великог апостола и јеванђелиста празнује се 26. септембра.“ — and which then says what the May day is for: „Но 8. маја спомиње се чудо пројављено од гроба његова.“, the wonder shown from his grave. **So the May day is a wonder and not a second repose**, the book itself sends the reader back to September, and this row's day stands. Nothing was moved, no second row was made and he does not render on 8 May; the May account is appended to his life. The same move `athanasius-of-alexandria` took on the Julian 2. мај ст. ст. of this wave, and for the same reason. Read 5 October 2026 at https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2026-05-21&prolog=1

source.text: Охридски пролог, 26. септембар ст. к. — «1. Св. Јован Богослов, апостол и јеванђелист.»

Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 июня ст. ст. — «Собор славных и всехвальных 12-ти апостолов: Петра, Андрея, брата его, Иакова Зеведеева, Иоанна, брата его, Филиппа, Варфоломея, Фомы, Матфея, Иакова Алфеева, Иуды Иаковля, или Фаддея, Симона Зилота и Матфия.»

attestations.note: The Synaxis of the Twelve, and the heading enumerates all twelve by name, so it is one row for each of the twelve and not one entry for the company: his place in the line is «Иоанна, брата его». This is a SECOND russian row and nothing was moved — the folder’s first russian row stands on the calendar’s own 26 сентября ст. ст. and is untouched. The day is listed among HIS days by the calendar itself, which is the test this row rests on: his name page heads «Дни памяти: 8 мая , 20 июня , 30 июня (12 ап.) , 26 сентября (Преставление)» (https://days.pravoslavie.ru/Life/life1608.htm), and «30 июня (12 ап.)» is in it. The day page prints three hymns under the synaxis heading — a troparion глас 4 and two kontakia глас 2 — and they are the synaxis’s own, printed under no single apostle’s name; none was copied into any apostle’s folder.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 мая ст. ст. — «Апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (98-117).»

attestations.note: A SECOND russian row, out of the withheld-second-day backlog. The folder’s first russian row stands on 26 сентября ст. ст. and was NOT moved, altered or re-sourced. Its own note already recorded this day and refused it in the words “one row per church is the schema” — the prohibition the author lifted on 2026-10-03, after which `attestationsIn` in src/lib/church.js has been plural by design and schema/saint.schema.json sets no uniqueness on `attestations`. **That sentence in the first row’s note is now wrong and this row supersedes it**; the note itself was left as it stands rather than rewritten, because copying a venerated row back to edit its prose is not what `replace_venerated` is sanctioned for. Three things were checked before this row was written, and the day rests on all three: the calendar’s own list of HIS days heads his name page — «Дни памяти: 8 мая , 20 июня , 30 июня (12 ап.) , 26 сентября (Преставление)» — and this day is in it; the day page for it prints a line for him, «Апостола и евангелиста Иоанна Богослова (98-117).», which is what the `source` quotes; and the name link behind that line is https://days.pravoslavie.ru/name/962.html, the same name page the folder’s existing row was read from. The folder now carries three russian rows: 26 сентября, his falling-asleep; 30 июня, the Synaxis of the Twelve; and this 8 мая, the day the calendar heads a day page with him alone and dates «(98-117)», Trajan’s reign, which is not the folder’s own reading and left `dates` untouched. **THE FOURTH DAY IN HIS LIST IS NOT WRITTEN AND IS NOT A ROW**: the 20 июня day page prints Methodius of Patara, Gleb of Vladimir, the martyrs Inna, Pinna and Rimma and a translation of the relics of Gurias of Kazan — not one line under his name and not one name link to page 962. His list names the day and the day page does not keep him on it, which is the one case in this backlog where the two halves of the test disagree; it is reported and left as a note. `thomas-the-apostle` has the same unexplained 20 июня and `andrew-the-first-called` has it marked «(Перенесение мощей)», and the day page keeps neither of them either.

hymns.text: Ἀπόστολε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ ἠγαπηπημένε, ἐπιτάχυνον, ῥῦσαι λαὸν ἀναπολόγητον, δέχεταί σε προσπίπτοντα, ὁ ἐπιπεσόντα τῷ στήθει καταδεξάμενος· ὃν ἱκέτευε, Θεολόγε, καὶ ἐπίμονον νέφος ἐθνῶν διασκεδάσαι, αἰτούμενος ἡμῖν εἰρήνην, καὶ τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: O Apostle beloved of Christ our God, make haste and deliver a people that has no defence; he who suffered thee to lean upon his breast receiveth thee as thou fallest down before him. Beseech him, O Theologian, to scatter the lingering cloud of the heathen, asking for us peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὰ μεγαλεῖά σου Παρθένε, τὶς διηγήσεται; βρύεις γὰρ θαύματα, καὶ πηγάζεις ἰάματα, καὶ πρεσβεύεις ὑπὲρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν, ὡς θεολόγος καὶ φίλος Χριστοῦ.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Θεολόγος (Μετάσταση), Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: Thy mighty deeds, O virgin, who shall tell? For thou gushest forth wonders and wellest up with healings, and intercedest for our souls, as theologian and friend of Christ.

hymns.text: Apostole al lui Hristos de Dumnezeu iubite, grăbeşte de izbăveşte pe poporul cel fără de răspuns. Că te primeşte când cazi către El, Cel ce te-a primit când te-ai rezemat pe pieptu-I; pe Care roagă-L, de Dumnezeu cuvântătorule, şi norul păgânilor cel pus asupra noastră să-l risipească, cerându-ne nouă pace şi mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Apostol și Evanghelist Ioan (8 mai)

english.text: Apostle of Christ beloved of God, hasten to deliver a people who have no defence. He receives thee when thou fallest before him, who received thee when thou didst lean on his breast; entreat him, theologian, to scatter the cloud of the heathen set over us, and ask for us peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Apostole iubite al lui Hristos Dumnezeu, grăbeşte de mântuieşte pe poporul cel fără de răspuns. Că te primeşte când cazi către Dânsul, Cel Ce te-a primit când te-ai rezemat pe pieptul Lui: pe Acela roagă-L, de Dumnezeu Cuvântătorule, ca norul vrăjmaşilor cel căzut asupra noastră să se risipească, cerându-ne nouă pace şi mare milă.

source.text: Doxologia — Tropar la Sărbătoarea Adormirii Sfântului Apostol şi Evanghelist Ioan

english.text: O Apostle beloved of Christ God, hasten to save a people that has no defence. He who received thee when thou didst lean upon His breast receives thee when thou fallest down before Him: entreat Him, O Theologian, that the cloud of enemies fallen upon us may be scattered, and that He may ask for us peace and great mercy.
